## LmdbSyncStream.run() method

Copy rows past the checkpoint through a keyset cursor in 500-row chunks.

**Signature:**

```typescript
run(): Promise<ISyncResult<S>>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;[ISyncResult](./lmdb.isyncresult.md)<!-- -->&lt;S&gt;&gt;

`{copied, checkpoint, verified}`<!-- -->.

## Exceptions

[LmdbError](./lmdb.lmdberror.md) On self-sync and verify divergence.

## Remarks

Each committed chunk advances the persisted cursor, so kills resume mid-stream. An explicit `checkpoint` runs one-shot without touching the stored cursor. Destination writes use `{sorted: true}` appends (source order is natively ascending). Sync upserts — destination-only rows are never deleted.
